findings.finding: Corrected the historical generic canvas claim. MapLibre JSX SourceProps excludes canvas although the entry exports its type and SDK addSource accepts it. The expected compiler error and assertion rerun are retained; choose a reproducible transport in S20.

Corrected the source table to distinguish required prop annotation from React JSX defaultProps: four RN source JSX ID omissions compile, while ImageSource omission fails. Retained the expected failure and passing expected-error assertion. Common one-map-react stable caller IDs remain required.

Both Source wrappers reuse matching style source IDs. Cleanup removes all layers referring to that source, not only child JSX layers. Explicit adapter ownership must prevent accidental adoption/deletion in S07/S09.

GeoJSON prop update detection calls setData, without applying altered clustering options or rebuilding. Detection iterates supplied new keys; removed-only options are not a recreation guarantee. Mutable/immutable/removal classification remains S07/S09 work.
Both web wrappers send undefined for removed paint/layout keys. Native wrappers forward transformed style props; equivalent observed default reset remains S08 evidence.

Current Style dispatch covers eight layer kinds and four sources; no DEM or raster-array dispatch. Source options are selectively translated, paint/layout merged and camel-cased, and sprites/glyphs ignored. It cannot serve as a complete adapter unchanged.

Native source component naming/required IDs, image URL or numeric host assets, frozen MapLibre IDs and RN raster/DEM legacy template-URL conversion reviewed. Numeric assets require explicit host resolution; common component IDs remain required.

RN expansion accepts string or feature; leaves/children accept number or feature, document collections, parse Android strings and otherwise return native payloads. MapLibre native declares numeric IDs and promised arrays. Mapbox3.32 callback source APIs must be promisified; MapLibre6.13 APIs are promises. Actual native payload/dispatch and cluster replacement behavior remain S24.

Point/rect ordering and async collection/array/synchronous array signatures checked. Source query return declarations are not full-dataset or identical loaded-tile scope proof. Native metadata/error/filter behavior remains S10b/S25.

RN uses map refs and required nullable removal key; MapLibre uses source refs, stringifies IDs and normalizes missing native state to null. Its documentation specifies dropped null object keys, retained null array elements and next-frame removal; native observations remain S11. Agreed one-map-react excludes null values, uses strings and resets after owned source/style replacement.

Current image entry resolution/missing callbacks, native Mapbox advanced exports, MapLibre Map light and exported specification types, and backend-specific web layer/type props checked. Native SDK/runtime support, loading/removal/recovery and property equivalence are separately staged.
